Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the proton as having the least mass. The premise of the question is to find the part with the *least* mass. Scientifically, an electron ($\approx 9.11 \times 10^{-31}$ kg) is approximately 1/1836 the mass of a proton ($\approx 1.67 \times 10^{-27}$ kg). The Planner's internal reasoning explicitly states that $1.67e-27 < 9.11e-27$, which is a false inequality ($10^{-27}$ is much larger than $10^{-31}$). Consequently, the Planner concluded "D) proton" instead of the correct answer "A) electron".
